summary: Independent review confirmed the Go registry, required-field checks, evidence path/hash validation, five-channel pair derivation, source SHA format, and actual 13-case certificate. It reproduced a must-fix: raw observedChannels unknown and duplicate entries are silently removed by canonicalization and still certify. Supplemental callback invocation metadata is also only presence-checked.

review.registryPolicy: Matches the independent 13-case plan, including backend/fault pairs, required/allowed channel policies, fault target paths and event 0, and healthy 50/46 counts.
review.requiredFieldsAndIntegrity: Raw report decoding rejects missing/unknown fields; evidence is report-relative and hashed; traversal and escaping symlinks are rejected.
review.channelDerivation: All five evidence comparison pairs are required and cross-checked to structured expected/observed fields; evidence-derived channels are checked against both evidence and raw claims after canonicalization.
review.activationAndSource: Fault record count, identity, event index, target path, and lowercase 40-hex source commit shape are validated. The certificate library does not bind sourceCommit to the final committed source pins; the delivery runner is responsible for that binding.
review.evidenceErrors: Exception-only and unactivated controls are rejected; page and infrastructure errors disqualify cases.
review.finding: Raw observedChannels accepts appended unknown names and duplicates because canonicalChannels drops unknown values and deduplicates. Evidence bytes and hash remained unchanged in both actual-capture probes.
review.secondaryLimitation: Supplemental activation/observed callbackInvocations metadata is not structurally validated or cross-bound. The dispatch-count channel itself is bound to observed.callbackCounts.dispatch.

negativeWitnesses.mutation: fault-react-text-corruption raw observedChannels appended duplicate dom
fault-react-drop-click callback metadata replaced with false/string/array/null and evidence hash recomputed
negativeWitnesses.expected: reject malformed supplemental callback count metadata if certificate claims to validate callback evidence

checks.result: Actual report certified 13/13; certificate exactly matches E-GO's saved certificate hash.

limitations: This review does not rerun browser capture or the complete delivery pipeline.
No Go, CLI, application, browser, Git, or scheduler source was changed by N5.
